tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the wizard body, result details.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset areas: technical log, input wells, table headers.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet card edges (decorative, never the only cue).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons. 3:1 on surface and bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text, captions, metadata on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main action fill (Start a new check, Continue), selected states, progress.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of primary actions.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected choice-card background, active nav item.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on bg and surface. Always underlined.

tokens.name: clear
tokens.usage: No known spyware: icon, heading accent, badge text on surface and clear-soft.

tokens.name: clear-soft
tokens.usage: No known spyware: result panel background, clean badge fill.

tokens.name: clear-border
tokens.usage: No known spyware: result panel and badge border. Decorative; the icon and words carry the meaning.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Something needs a closer look: icon, heading accent, badge text on surface and attention-soft. Calm amber, not alarm red.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Something needs a closer look: result panel background, badge fill.

tokens.name: attention-border
tokens.usage: Something needs a closer look: result panel and badge border. Decorative; the icon and words carry the meaning.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Severity chip text for a single critical finding row only. Never a page-level colour.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Severity chip fill for critical findings.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notes and tips: icon and text on surface and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tip and privacy note background.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: In-progress ring and badge, same family as primary so a running check feels steady.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero question and result headline. One per screen.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Screen title: New check, Past checks, the check name.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Wizard question, section heading on results.
styles.sample: Which kind of phone are you checking?

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Default reading size for explanations on result and wizard screens.
styles.sample: This is not proof that the phone is infected.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Card body, lists, form help text.
styles.sample: Any iPhone or iPad running iOS or iPadOS.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata (dates, file counts). Never for instructions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Step counter, field labels, badges. Sentence case, not all caps.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: File paths, technical log, matched values. Always behind a disclosure or in a sunken well.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label above input, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, list row inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (phone), between form groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), result hero padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page top padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, result hero, choice cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and the step dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards. Quiet: no glows.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: Result hero only.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of primary next-step buttons. Big, easy targets.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, inputs, nav items. Never below 44px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max reading width of a screen's main column.
